UGC-NET Exam Leak Sparks Concerns Over Examination Process

The UGC-NET exam leak has raised concerns about the examination process, with allegations of paper leaks and irregularities. The incident has sparked a debate over the government's handling of the issue. The Education Ministry has proposed a computer-based test for NEET-UG 2027, which is expected to be implemented soon.
